description:
In the NHL, one of the league’s most treasured traditions is that each player and key staff member from the Stanley Cup–winning team gets to spend an entire day with the Cup. It’s a rare chance to celebrate with loved ones and hometown communities in creative and meaningful ways. Whether it’s taking the Cup fishing, eating cereal out of it, or bringing it to hospitals and local rinks, this legendary trophy has traveled the globe and been part of countless unforgettable stories. It’s a personal reward that makes capturing the Stanley Cup even more special—and undeniably legendary.
The 2025 Stanley Cup Digital Collectible celebrates that tradition, capturing the emotion, pride, and thrill of raising hockey’s most iconic trophy. Featuring players past and present, it’s a tribute to the legacy of champions. If you had the Cup for a day, how would you spend it?

These unique collectibles are part of a community experience, enabling users to touch the Cup. They were first distributed to 23 random collectors that were part of a successful trade for a Hoist the Cup 2025 highlight before Thursday, July 24 at 11:59pm PT.
Here's how the community event works:
- 23 total 2025 Stanley Cup Digital Collectibles distributed Monday, July 28, at 6:00pm PT.
- Once a week, at an undisclosed time, a snapshot is taken of all 23 Digital Collectible holders.
- Collectors that were the last to pass the 2025 Stanley Cup Digital Collectible to a new collector before that week’s snapshot score a random airdrop pack from the Drops page!
- Each collector can only earn one airdrop during the 2025 Stanley Cup Digital Collectible community event.
- All 23 Digital Collectibles are reclaimed around October 1, 2025.
